tool: OpenChemIE 0.1.0 (git d9b50bb; MolScribe 1m a018977, MolDet 7cf4ba5, PubLayNet EfficientDet-D1 98c70a9)

rebuilt_labels.rule: an enumerated label takes the RDKit molzip join of its backbone and groups when its SMILES is the naive paste (each group's text, minus its leading [*:n], written over that [*:n] in the backbone text), the join parses, the join is another molecule, the paste with the groups' ring-closure digits renumbered to digits the backbone does not use is the join, no [*:n] starts the backbone, and no ring of 4 or fewer atoms in the backbone has 3 or more atoms written aromatic

scoring.match: exact RDKit canonical SMILES, stereo-aware and stereo-stripped
